events.name: 28th Annual CRWC Boom Box Parade
events.place: River Gardens Dr & Hancock Rd to Alona Way, Bullhead City
events.description: Bullhead City's holiday parade, themed American Christmas this year, with decorated floats and vehicles from local businesses, schools, nonprofits and first responders. Bring chairs; the route runs from River Gardens Dr & Hancock Rd to Alona Way.

events.name: Holly Jolly Holiday Bazaar
events.place: Anderson Auto Group Fieldhouse, Bullhead City
events.note: Hours listed in Arizona time; confirm with the organizer.
events.description: A holiday bazaar at the Anderson Auto Group Fieldhouse across the river in Bullhead City, listed by the Laughlin Chamber.

events.name: Nik at Nite – A Jazzy Holiday Concert
events.place: Laughlin Library, 2840 S Needles Hwy
events.description: Nik sings classic holiday songs in a Sinatra-style sing-along. Free and open to the public; seating is first come, first served.

events.name: Light the Belle
events.place: Bullhead Belle, Community Park, Bullhead City
events.description: Thousands of holiday lights switch on at the Bullhead Belle on the Colorado River at sundown. The lights stay up through the holiday season for photos and evening strolls.

events.name: Graham Cracker Cottages
events.place: Laughlin Library, 2840 S Needles Hwy
events.description: Kids build holiday houses out of graham crackers, candy and frosting. Ages 0–17 welcome; free while supplies last.

events.name: Christmas on the Colorado Lighted Boat Parade
events.place: Colorado River (watch from the Laughlin Riverwalk or Bullhead City Community Park)
events.description: Decorated boats light up the Colorado River at sunset. Watch from anywhere along the river, or from the Bullhead Belle.

events.name: Desert Artisan Exchange
events.place: Aquarius Casino Resort, 1900 S Casino Dr, Laughlin
events.description: A seasonal art and craft market with 40–90 curated artists, makers and designers. This December weekend is the first of five monthly market weekends running through April 2027.

events.name: Gobble Wobble Little Turkey Trot
events.place: Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City
events.description: Gobble Wobble Little Turkey Trot at Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City. Ages 2–14. Free with registration.

events.name: Bullhead City Christmas Craft Show
events.place: Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City
events.description: Bullhead City Christmas Craft Show at Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City. Holiday crafts.

events.name: Christmas Tree & Wreath Fest
events.place: The Venue 837, Bullhead City
events.description: Christmas Tree & Wreath Fest at The Venue 837, Bullhead City. Holiday trees and wreaths.

events.name: International Gifts & Crafts Show
events.place: Aquarius Casino Resort, Laughlin
events.description: International Gifts & Crafts Show at Aquarius Casino Resort, Laughlin. Free.

events.name: Welcome Christmas Pajama Party
events.place: Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City
events.description: Welcome Christmas Pajama Party at Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City. Free with registration.

events.name: The Great Christmas Carnival
events.place: Anderson Auto Group Fieldhouse, Bullhead City
events.description: The Great Christmas Carnival at Anderson Auto Group Fieldhouse, Bullhead City. Free.

events.name: Christmas on the City Hall Deck
events.place: Bullhead City Hall, 2355 Trane Rd
events.description: Christmas on the City Hall Deck at Bullhead City Hall, 2355 Trane Rd. Free. Holiday fun with Santa.

events.name: New Year, Fresh Start Farmers Market
events.place: Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City
events.description: New Year, Fresh Start Farmers Market at Optimum Community Center, Bullhead City. Free.

events.name: Laughlin Library Annual Book Sale
events.place: Laughlin Library, 2840 S Needles Hwy
events.description: The Laughlin Library's annual sale of books, magazines, DVDs and CDs.

events.name: Personal Winter Wonderland
events.place: Laughlin Library, 2840 S Needles Hwy
events.description: Make fake snow from common household ingredients and take home your own piece of winter.

events.name: 12th Annual Slab-O-Rama BBQ Challenge
events.place: Rotary Park, 2315 Balboa Dr, Bullhead City
events.description: A Kansas City Barbeque Society state championship cook-off at Bullhead City's Rotary Park. Check with the organizer for public tasting or vendor hours.

events.name: SNORE Rage at the River Off-Road Race
events.place: Laughlin Events Park (spectator pits off Bruce Woodbury Dr)
events.note: Free for spectators. Bring sun and ear protection and closed-toe shoes.
events.description: Southern Nevada Off Road Enthusiasts' season-ending desert race (Riverside Hotel Rage at the River) with trucks, buggies and UTVs racing the Laughlin desert course.

events.name: Mohave College Shines: Holiday Fun with Santa
events.place: Mohave College Bullhead City Campus, 3400 Highway 95, Bullhead City
events.note: Family event with photos with Santa and light refreshments.
events.description: Mohave College's holiday kickoff at its Bullhead City campus, with photos with Santa, crafts with Blaze and friends, holiday entertainment from around the world, and North Pole Travel Books for kids to stamp at each station.

events.name: Lights in the Park & Christmas Tree Lighting
events.place: Gary Keith Civic Center Park, 2295 Hoppas Dr, Bullhead City
events.note: Free. Tree lighting at 8pm Laughlin time (9pm Arizona).
events.description: Holiday light displays you can vote on, Bullhead City's Christmas tree lighting, hot dogs, hot cocoa and adult beverages, right after the Boom Box Parade. Presented by Community Pride Advocates to benefit Harmony Park.

events.name: 25th Annual Black Mountain Art Show
events.place: Mohave College Bullhead Campus, Room 600, 3400 Highway 95, Bullhead City
events.note: Free. Artist reception Nov 20, 4–6pm Laughlin time (5–7pm Arizona).
events.description: The River Valley Artists Guild's free exhibition of work by Colorado River Valley artists, with an artist reception and awards on Friday, Nov 20.

events.name: Free Santa Photos at The Venue 837
events.place: The Venue 837, 837 Hancock Rd, Bullhead City
events.note: Free photos with Santa and a kids' craft.
events.description: Free photos with Santa and a holiday craft for kids, benefiting CASA Council Helping Children of Mohave County.

events.name: Oatman Christmas Bush Decorating
events.place: Oatman Hwy / Main Street, Oatman, AZ
events.time: Any time; bush numbers at Jackass Junction Nov 20
events.description: Oatman's holiday tradition: decorate a desert bush along the road to Oatman. Pick up a bush number at Jackass Junction on Nov 20; judging is Dec 20 and cleanup is Jan 10.
know: No glass ornaments, batteries or edible decorations.
The decorated bushes are free to drive by and view.
